We also found material related to the Confessarius experiments. These files may help Rhodes Island better understand their movements.
eventSerialChoice_3_5_3.failureDesc:
We failed to understand the significance of the special communicator's signal.
Our team will abandon this lead and look for another way to enter Londinium.

broadcast_1.content: Arriving at conflict zone. Please ensure the team has enough supplies.

broadcast_2.content: Each team has their own unique strengths, so let them fully make of them.

broadcast_3.content: Some event decisions may affect future situations.

broadcast_4.content: The Sarkaz are congregating away from Londinium, and this squad boasts elites from both the Vampire and Nachzehrer Royal Courts.

broadcast_5.content: A Catastrophe is currently on the move to the west of Westbound Forest.

broadcast_6.content: The Victorian Army is withdrawing from the western frontline and moving towards the Silverrock Bluffs on the Duskglow River—Redmane Mountains line.

broadcast_7.content: Squads led by Operators Closure, Fang, and Misery have reached the battlefield and are preparing to establish a comms network. All teams, please provide support alongside your duties.

broadcast_8.content: Take note: each has their own strengths, and no squad can perfectly handle every problem they encounter.

broadcast_10.content: Confessarius guards are fighting alongside strange enemies called 'Chimeras.' Avoid direct engagement.

broadcast_11.content: Both the Victorian and Sarkaz armies have gathered at Silverrock Bluffs and may start a conflict any time.

broadcast_12.content: The Nachzehrer can employ witchcraft to conjure fog and mire. Watch out for their ambushes when encountering such terrain.

broadcast_13.content: The Iron Duke's troops are leading the Victorian army's effort against the Sarkaz army.

broadcast_14.content: The battlefield is still deteriorating. Make sure your squad is well-equipped with all kinds of supplies.

broadcast_15.content: Some events only occur at certain times. If you miss them, you will not see them for the rest of the run.

broadcast_16.content: Siege has led the Exemplars to victory against the Sarkaz legion at Silverrock Bluffs, using the Sighs of Kings to lower the area's levels of active Originium.

broadcast_17.content: The clouds are gone, and the sky shows itself again. Following the victory at Silverrock Bluffs, the Victorian Army has received a great boost to morale, and the counteroffensive begins.

broadcast_18.content: The team ahead has sent word of a mutual aid group of Infected that has been taking in refugees from the battlefield and is moving towards Londinium.

broadcast_19.content: The Sarkaz legion is currently retreating towards Londinium. A small number decided to desert, but the majority hold onto their formations.

broadcast_20.content: Be wary of large abandoned military equipment on the field. Keep your distance, for unstable energy components can cause an explosion at any moment.

broadcast_21.content: According to the team ahead, the large Catastrophe to the west of Londinium has stopped in its tracks, and the route from Westbound Forest to the city can be reopened.

broadcast_22.content: The Iron Duke has led his forces to withdraw from the Victorian Army camp. Now the identifiers of all troops bearing the Wellington flag have been changed from 'friendly' to 'unknown.'

broadcast_23.content: Our situation will only get worse. Prepare yourselves.

broadcast_24.content: Londinium is right before us. Prepare yourselves.

broadcast_25.content: Lost teams will return to Rhodes Island after a period of rest.

broadcast_26.content: The Sarkaz army is constructing a defense line around Londinium with witchcraft turrets and altars on the city walls. Try to get around them and avoid direct engagement.

broadcast_27.content: The Victorian forces are split along three paths trying to surround Londinium from the west, south, and east, while the Sarkaz army did not venture outside to intercept them.

broadcast_28.content: The battle outside Londinium has ended. We're grateful to every squad for your hard work.

broadcast_29.content: The first-responder team responsible for cleaning the battlefield and preventing active Originium from spreading has set off towards Silverrock Bluffs to treat the wounded.

broadcast_30.content: The situation in the outskirts of Londinium has stabilized. Per our analyses, the next battle will break out near the city.
